Temporal Workflows and Schedules
Workflows are defined in
shared/workflows/
and run by
the worker in
workflow_worker/
(
main.py
registers workflows, activities and schedules). Activities call the
backend System APIs; the backend owns the domain logic.

ReservationRequestWorkflow
Send “request received” email to the customer.
Wait for signal
routed_to_providers
or
reservation_request_closed
. Open/custom requests wait
indefinitely.
On routing, start one child
OfferingLifecycleWorkflow
per offering.
Wait until any child is Contracted, all children finish, or the
parent is closed.
If one contracts: cancel siblings (superseded) and approve the
request.
If all expire: send one consolidated customer expiry email and
expire the request.
Closure reasons send emails: Cancelled (customer + NCPs), Rejected,
Matched, Unserviceable.
Signals:
routed_to_providers
,
reservation_request_closed
. Child workflow retry up to 100
attempts; expire activity 20 attempts over about 75 minutes.
OfferingLifecycleWorkflow
Send the magic-link email (critical retry policy).
Acceptance phase (7 days by default): reminder 3 days before; on
timeout expire the offering and email the NCP.
On
provider_accepted
: send the introduction email;
start the contract phase (45 days).
Reminder 3 days before contract expiry; on timeout expire and
email.
On
offering_contracted
: send contracted email. On
reject or cancel: handle and email (superseded if a sibling won).
Signals:
provider_accepted
,
acceptance_expiry_extended
,
contract_expiry_extended
,
offering_contracted
,
offering_rejected
,
offering_cancelled
.
CsvImportWorkflow
VALIDATING → IMPORTING → (if future rows) PENDING_REVIEW: email
admins and wait for
approve_import
/
reject_import
→ activate or reject offerings → email the
NCP. Activities:
validate_csv
,
execute_atomic_import
,
activate_offerings
,
reject_offerings
,
update_import_job_status
,
notify_admin_for_review
,
notify_provider_result
. Workflow max attempts 1; import
activities 3 attempts.
ProviderOnboardingWorkflow
validate_provider_csv
→
execute_provider_onboarding
(30-minute timeout) →
notify_onboarding_complete
(sent even on failure). 3
attempts; validation errors are not retried.
Salesforce workflows
SfdcCreateBatchWorkflow
drains the
salesforce_create_sync
outbox.
Create
mode
retries 13 times every 5 minutes;
status
mode runs once
per tick. Gated by
SFDC_SYNC_ENABLED
; when false, schedules
are deleted and the workflow is not registered.
SfdcPartnerDomainSyncWorkflow
is gated by
SFDC_PARTNER_DOMAIN_SYNC_ENABLED
. It refuses empty or
suspiciously shrunk snapshots so partners are not mass-demoted.
